description: HELCOM hotspots is a dataset listed in HELCOM Metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.helcom.fi. This dataset consists of information and status of the main pollution sources within the Baltic Sea catchment area (the Pollution Hot Spots). The HELCOM pollution Hot Spots were idenitified in 1992 by the HELCOM Joint Comprehensive Action Programme (more information is available on www.helcom.fi). The current status of active and cleaned hot spots is available. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Production and industrial facilities, MADS, Utility and governmental services. The listing shows 2025-04-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-helcom-fi.
